items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He just sang percussion on there. I didn’t know he was a singer.

ctx.x: Yeah. He just sang percussion on there. I didn’t know he was a singer. It’s like Harvey Mason. Harvey Mason was percussion on all “The Cosby Show.” I didn’t know Harvey was a drummer then. I didn’t find out until two years later he was a drummer. He was on percussion.

It seems again, being at the beginning of something again – and I refuse to believe that these things are just strictly by accident. I think they might be fate kind of things – but it was six or seven years before anybody tried that again.
